note: How a model tier's vertices map to an asset's regions when the tier carries no `_EVANI_PART` byte and no glTF material named after a region (evani-style-geo source.rs, WP2 of docs/studio/WORK_PACKAGES.md). Steps are tried in order, the first that matches wins, and the last must match anything. `material`: the vertex's glTF material name. `along`, `around`, `distal`, `length`: the body chart `_EVANI_REGION` (0..1 each), as [min, max): min inclusive, max exclusive. `proxies`: solid shapes the tier lacks, built from its own anchors (evani-style-geo proxy.rs), added only when no vertex already holds that region. Every name is a region of the asset's row; `cargo xtask check` refuses one that isn't.

animal.horse.chart: the horse v5 body chart: along runs muzzle 0 to dock 1 on the body, distal grows down a leg and out along an ear (horse-model branch, evani_material_recipes::region). The leg region starts at distal 0.52 (about the knee and hock), where a bay's black points begin; lower values paint the shoulders and hips.
